recipes.name: Mostaccioli with Spinach and Feta
ingredients_raw: 10 ounces fresh spinach, washed and chopped

steps.text: Cook pasta according to package directions. Drain, and set aside.

Heat oil in a large pot. Add tomatoes, spinach, and garlic; cook and stir 2 minutes, or until spinach is wilted and mixture is thoroughly heated. Add pasta and cheese; cook 1 minute. Season to taste with salt and pepper.

raw_recipe.headline: Mostaccioli with Spinach and Feta
raw_recipe.description: Flavorful feta cheese, studded with bits of tomato and basil, is tossed with hot pasta into a saute of fresh tomatoes, baby spinach and minced garlic for a colorful, aromatic meal.

review.reviewBody: I'm giving this recipe 4 stars when it's made as written. It's good and very nutritious, but it's a little bland. However, the second time I made it I used two 15 ounce cans of diced tomatoes with basil, garlic, and oregano, and that gave the dish the flavor kick that it needed. With that change, I might give this recipe 5 stars.

Wow. I used two large garlic cloves instead of 1, then I added 1 whole can of "La San Marzano" tomatoes (once you have had these you will never buy anything else) and I used only 4 oz of Macedonia Feta (extra creamy Feta) and added 1/4 cup of homemade pesto. 6 strips of crumbled crisp bacon. I don't really like Penn I find it too big & rubbery so I replaced it with a medium Fricelli pasta, it's small rolled ovals. Some of them open up when cooked. I added the cooked pasta and spinach and cooed it until the spinach was just wilted. Believe me there was nothing boring about this meal, it was amazing.

My entire family loved this! I made the following ingredient modifications: an entire package of whole wheat penne, 2 - 14.5 oz. cans of diced tomatos with garlic, basil & oregano. I cooked 3 cloves of garlic in oil for a few, then added the spinach, then added the canned tomatos after the spinach was wilted. I cooked it altogether till the tomatos were nice and hot. After that, I tossed it in with the pasta and a couple ounces of feta. I let that cook for about a minute until the feta had metled, then sprinkled a couple more ounces of feta on top, stirred and served.

We loved this! I had about a cup of leftover mushrooms which I sauteed first with the garlic before adding the rest as per recipe. We cannot get basil feta locally, so I also added a bunch of fresh, chopped basil. Just delicious! Will be making it again and again! Added bonus that it is so quick and easy. Thanks for this one!

Great base recipe.. I used what I had on hand: fresh spinach, grape tomatoes, whole wheat penne and 4 oz of chevre. I feel like 8 oz would've been way too much. I also added a bit of salt and pepper to the sauteed veggies, and cooked the garlic by itself for a bit before adding in the tomatoes, then the spinach. Also, I didnt cook the penne all the way- about a minute short, then saute with the spinach mix, i think it adds a bit more flavor to the pasta.
Delicious dish!!!! A new favorite. I added more garlic and also added some thinly sliced chicken and some kalamata olives and some artichoke hearts. We love this!!
I have made this recipe, however I add boneless, skinless chicken breast, mushrooms, zucchini and instead of chopped tomatoes, I use grape tomatoes. Very delicious and a family favorite!

This is so easy, so healthy and delicious. I used fat free feta as recommended by others, increased the garlic to 3 cloves ( one can never have too much fresh garlic) and found it unnecessary to chop the spinach (just dump it in and save scores of time). I was very pleased and to quote my husband who has a discriminating palate, " ....this is definately a home run!"
I can see throwing in some grilled chicken or shrimp to make a hearty crowd pleasing meal.
I cooked garlic first with some shrimp, then added italian herb tomatoes and spinach. Added some crushed red pepper for heat and some Mrs. Dash. I also used garlic and herb feta. Loved it!
As is, I can imagine that the pasta would taste dry. I added some light cream and allowed the feta to melt to create more of a sauce and it was a tasty pasta dish!

It was really good, but I made a fair amount changes as well, after reading reviews that it needed more flavor. I added more garlic (about four cloves) and red pepper flakes, as well as used the whole wheat penne.

I also added meat, by seasoning chicken with garlic powder, fresh basil leaves, red pepper flakes, seasoning salt and pepper, and smothered in 1/2 jar seasoned spaghetti sauce, baking for 13 minutes. It added great flavor to the dish.
Loved this recipe. Flowed exactly. Fresh, healthy & delicious as is!
Added chicken and shrimp with it. Kids and wife loved it!
Loved it will use it for Lenten meals and then add meat on other days.
Added basil & Itsluan dressing when eating it cold. Needs garlic salt also
This dish is amazing! It is so easy and so delicious and flavorful that I make it at least once a week! Thank you!
Did it exactly as in the recipe. I used mini penne and it turned out delicious. My kids loved it as did my vegetarian guests.
I added oregano and balsamic vinegar and used original feta so I also cooked in some fresh basil. My picky son loved it and my Husband loved it as well!!
Was very good. The only thing I did different was I added more tomato, oregano, basil and more garlic. But that was just my preference. :) very yummy with smoked sausage too.

This is my go to pasta dish when I'm looking for something more than traditional spaghetti with tomato sauce and to incorporate extra veggies! I make it exactly as recipe calls for....a crowd pleaser everytime and leftovers are great!!!
